name: claude V01 vehicle restoration opens without exception (block path + radial select path)

steps._note: CLASS: FIXTURE-DEPENDENT. PART 1 (block path) is RUNNABLE on a fresh save with no radial. PART 2 (entity Service radial) uses the implemented radial select step {"radialSelect":{"command":"service"}} (POST /radial/select). VEHICLE FIXTURE (verified from source 20261022). The restoration window has TWO entries. (A) BLOCK path, deterministic, no radial: block repairableVehicle4x4Rebirth (Config/_Vehicles/blocks.xml, Class BlockRepairableVehicleRebirth, RebirthVehicleContentId Base4x4, vehicle_entity_class vehicleTruck4x4, MaxDamage 2500, fuel 0-15 %, size 2x2x5) is placed with the bridge `setblock`, then `activate x y z block=1`; its activation command text is "Restore Vehicle" (xuiRebirthVehicleRestore, "Restore Vehicle (n/m parts)" once parts exist; Scripts/Vehicles/Restoration/RebirthVehicleRestorationSystem.cs OnBlockActivated -> XUiC_RebirthVehicleRestoration.Open). Sibling blocks: repairableVehicleBicycleRebirth, ...MinibikeRebirth, ...MotorcycleRebirth, ...GyrocopterRebirth. (B) ENTITY path: a vehicleTruck4x4 entity created from a vehicle ITEM carrying the RebirthVehicleAssembly metadata (placed with vanilla item vehicleTruck4x4Placeable, 8 mod slots, or rebirthBuggyPlaceable / rebirthBikePlaceable from Config/_Vehicles/standard_items.xml); its native Service radial entry is intercepted (RebirthVehicleRestorationSystem.cs ~4740: StartInteraction -> OpenEntity). A bare `spawn entity=vehicleTruck4x4` has NO item metadata and the patch REFUSES service ("refusing service: payloadPresent=false"), so it cannot be used. Entity repair needs Health below max (Repair button) and fuel below max (Refuel); both are cleared in the fixture by damaging it (not scriptable offline: NOT VERIFIABLE) and by giving ammoGasCan. Coordinates 14,45,~996 come from the CodexTest terrain used by vehicle_bike_native_placement.json and camper fixtures and must be re-checked with `terrain`/`openground`.
PART 2: entity path. Place the truck from its item exactly like vehicle_bike_native_placement.json (give to toolbelt, select, Secondary press at a fixed look point).
radialSelect: choose the Service entry (button label: native Service; if the radial lists it under another label read it from the radial reply above).
Read Player.log: any "[REBIRTH VehicleLock] dispatcher exception", "open refused: vehicle bag missing" or "refusing service" line is a finding (absence cannot be asserted, gap G8).
